# funnel_custom_metric (Data Source)

Reads an existing custom metric. Use it to copy a metric, including rules built in the Funnel UI, to another workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copy a metric built in the Funnel UI from one workspace to another
data "funnel_custom_metric" "source" {
  workspace = var.source_workspace_id
  id        = var.source_metric_id
}

resource "funnel_custom_metric" "copy" {
  workspace   = var.target_workspace_id
  name        = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.name
  description = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.description
  unit        = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.unit
  aggregation = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.aggregation
  precision   = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.precision
  derived     = data.funnel_custom_metric.source.derived
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Custom metric ID
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID the custom metric belongs to

### Read-Only

- `aggregation` (String) Custom metric aggregation type
- `derived` (String) JSON-encoded rules for how the metric is calculated. Null if the metric has no rules.
- `description` (String) Custom metric description
- `name` (String) Custom metric name
- `precision` (Number) Custom metric precision
- `unit` (String) Custom metric unit type
